articles.snippet: BUDAPEST – McLaren boss Andrea Stella has excused Carlos Sainz after Oscar Piastri raged at the team’s former driver for a costly collision during the Hungarian Grand Prix on July 26. Spaniard Sainz, now at Williams, clashed with Piastri while the Australian was trying to lap him and retain the lead after his second pit stop .
